name: Do I need to replace the garage door during conversion?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to replace the garage door during conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically yes—the garage door opening must be closed with a framed wall, insulated, and fitted with windows or solid sheathing plus a 6-inch concrete curb if the driveway slopes toward the opening.
